rules.title: Los Angeles RSO Annual Rent Increase Limit
rules.requirement: Landlords of rental units subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) may increase rent by no more than 3% per year. Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.quotedSpan: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%. Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.

rules.coverageDescription: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance. To determine if a unit is covered, tenants and landlords must check the unit's registration status using the ZIMAS database or contact LAHD.

The source references checking ZIMAS (zimas.lacity.gov) to determine RSO coverage but does not detail those criteria.
The rent increase applies from July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026; the effective date of this specific 3% allowance is July 1, 2025, which falls within the query date range (as of 2026-10-01).
The utility increase restriction effective February 2, 2026 is stated separately and may represent a modification to prior RSO rules.

rules.title: Rent Increase Notice Requirement
rules.effectiveDateQuote: State law requires landlords to provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
rules.requirement: Landlords must provide at least 30 days' written advance notice before implementing a rent increase of less than 10%.
rules.citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.4 or related CA statute
rules.quotedSpan: State law requires landlords to provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in California.
warnings: Source does not cite the specific California statute; the citation is inferred from established California notice requirements. The source material does not provide a precise effective date for this state law requirement.

rules.title: RSO and SCEP Surcharge Passthrough to Tenants
rules.effectiveDateQuote: Effective January 1, 2020, the RSO fee is a total of $38.75 per unit which landlords may collect from tenants at a rate of $1.61 per month for 12 months each year with a proper written notice. Effective January 1, 2022, the SCEP fee is a total of $67.94 per unit which landlords may collect from tenants at a rate of $2.83 per month for 12 months each year with a proper written notice.
rules.requirement: Landlords may pass through RSO and Systematic Code Enforcement Program (SCEP) surcharges to tenants with proper written notice. The RSO surcharge is $1.61 per month ($38.75 annually per unit, effective January 1, 2020). The SCEP surcharge is $2.83 per month ($67.94 annually per unit, effective January 1, 2022). Both surcharges are separate from rent and can only be collected after the landlord registers the units.
rules.quotedSpan: Effective January 1, 2020, the RSO fee is a total of $38.75 per unit which landlords may collect from tenants at a rate of $1.61 per month for 12 months each year with a proper written notice. Effective January 1, 2022, the SCEP fee is a total of $67.94 per unit which landlords may collect from tenants at a rate of $2.83 per month for 12 months each year with a proper written notice.
